delivery_notes: Complimentary white-glove packaging. Dispatched from our Vermont & Copenhagen fulfillment centers.
about_html:
Kstore is an architectural design studio and direct-to-consumer home goods house founded on the conviction that physical objects should bring enduring calm, effortless utility, and stillness to the modern dwelling.

We work exclusively with FSC-certified solid hardwoods, honed ceramic stoneware, and aerospace anodized aluminum. Born out of a desire for fewer, better essentials, our pieces are engineered with precision joinery to endure for generations across international residences.
faq_html:
What is your white-glove delivery process?

Every timber furnishing order over $150 receives complimentary white-glove home placement. Our couriers schedule a convenient 2-hour window, carry items to your room of choice, and remove all protective packaging.

How should I care for natural solid white oak?

Dust lightly with a dry microfiber cloth. For routine care, wipe along the timber grain with a damp cloth and mild plant-based soap. We recommend conditioning with organic beeswax twice annually.

How does the 30-Day in-home trial work?

Experience our essentials in your own lighting and room layout for 30 days. If an item does not suit your space, contact our concierge for a complimentary pickup and a 100% refund.

What does the 10-Year craft warranty cover?

We guarantee all mortise-and-tenon structural joinery, drawer runners, and timber frames against defects under residential usage for 10 years from delivery.
privacy_html:
At Kstore, client data governance is an uncompromising principle. We collect only information vital to coordinating white-glove deliveries, providing architectural fit recommendations, and honoring client transactions.

All digital payments and credentials are encrypted using modern TLS 1.3 cryptographic protocols. We maintain a strict zero-tolerance policy against selling, renting, or monetizing patron records to third-party advertising brokers.
terms_html:
By acquiring goods through the Kstore catalog, patrons enter an agreement grounded in transparent consumer protection, sustainable manufacturing, and uncompromising craft integrity.

All orders are backed by our signature 30-day in-home trial period and a 10-year structural warranty on natural timber joinery and internal components.
